A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the learners of English in the EFL context have been exposed to the native speakerism and the notion of native speakers and nonnative speakers.
we have found that young learners of English are more likely to be influenced by native speakerism, and that they tend to exhibit affiliation and dis- affiliation with different varieties of English.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to pay attention to the notion of WEs and EIL or ELF to promote the awareness among learners and teachers alike.
we should not be overly concerned about native speaker pronunciation, but rather focus on the intelligibility and appropriateness of language use.
